responsibility: Implements GCC’s public SSE2 intrinsic header for x86. It introduces the SSE2 vector and aliasing types such as __m128i and __m128d, conditionally enables the sse2 target option, and defines the large inline API for SSE2 scalar and packed floating-point, integer, memory, shuffle, cache, fence, and cast operations by mapping standard intrinsic names onto GCC vector expressions and x86 builtins.
